spells/power-word-blind-2566.effectSummary: Instantly blinds one creature with 200 hit points or fewer, whether or not it can hear the word. The duration is based on the target's current hit points: 50 or fewer, permanent; 51–100, 1d4+1 minutes; 101–200, 1d4+1 rounds. A creature with 201 or more current hit points is unaffected.
